verse.verse_1: O the Cloaked One! (Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him)
verse.verse_3: And proclaim the Purity of your Lord.
verse.verse_6: And do not favour others in order to receive more.
verse.verse_7: And for the sake of your Lord, patiently endure.
verse.verse_8: So when the Trumpet will be blown.
verse.verse_9: So that is a tough day.
verse.verse_11: Leave him to Me, the one whom I created single.
verse.verse_13: And gave him sons present before him.
verse.verse_14: And made several preparations for him.
verse.verse_15: Yet he desires that I should give more.
verse.verse_16: Never! For he is an enemy to Our signs!
verse.verse_17: Soon I shall mount him on Saood, the hill of fire.
verse.verse_18: Indeed he thought, and inwardly decided.
verse.verse_19: So accursed be he, how evilly did he decide!
verse.verse_20: Again accursed be he, how evilly did he decide!
verse.verse_21: He then dared to lift his gaze.
verse.verse_23: Then he turned away, and was haughty.
verse.verse_24: And said, “This is nothing but magic learnt from earlier men.”
verse.verse_25: “This is nothing but the speech of a man.”
verse.verse_26: I will soon fling him into hell.
verse.verse_27: And what have you understood, what hell is!
verse.verse_29: It strips away the hide of man.
verse.verse_31: We have not appointed the guards of hell, except angels; and did not keep this number except to test the disbelievers – in order that the People given the Book(s) may be convinced, and to increase the faith of the believers – and so that the People given the Book(s) and the Muslims may not have any doubt – and so that those in whose hearts is a disease and the disbelievers, may say, “What does Allah mean by this amazing example?” This is how Allah sends astray whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills; and no one knows the armies of Allah except Him; and this is not but an advice to man.
verse.verse_32: Yes, never!* By oath of the moon. (Hell will never spare the disbelievers).
verse.verse_33: And by oath of the night when it turns back.
verse.verse_34: And by oath of the morning, when it spreads light.
verse.verse_35: Indeed hell is one of the greatest entities.
verse.verse_37: For the one among you who wishes to come forward or stay back.
verse.verse_38: Every soul is mortgaged for its own deeds.
verse.verse_39: Except those on the right side.
verse.verse_43: They said, “We never used to offer the prayer.”
verse.verse_45: “And used to dwell on evil matters with those who think evilly.”
verse.verse_46: “And used to deny the Day of Justice.”
verse.verse_48: So the intercession of the intercessors will not benefit them. (The disbelievers will not have any intercessor.)
verse.verse_49: So what is the matter with them that they turn away from the advice?
verse.verse_50: As if they were startled donkeys –
verse.verse_52: Rather each one of them desires that he should be given open Books.
verse.verse_53: Never! In fact they do not fear the Hereafter.
verse.verse_54: Yes indeed, this is an advice.
verse.verse_55: So whoever wills may heed advice from it.
verse.verse_56: And what advice will they heed, except if Allah wills? Only He deserves to be feared, and His only is the greatness of forgiving.
